shared_elements: repeated short vertical strokes arranged in a row/register
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces bear purely linear, schematic incised marks, and both contain rows of small repeated strokes/signs aligned along horizontal registers. But A depicts a single large boat-like object with a hull, cross-struts and a fringe of crew strokes, while B is an undifferentiated field of dense, uniform script-like signs covering the whole surface with no representational motif at all.
